neighbours.label: the first plural noun of a pair after 'between the' (between the host plants and the bacteria)
fire: The drug blocks signals between the donor cells and the tumor.
Bad feeling grew between the mothers and the teachers.
Data flows between the client nodes and the database.
Friction arose between the tenant farmers and the owners.
Trade routes ran between the coastal towns and the mines.
The treaty keeps peace between the mountain tribes and the state.
It measures links between the host genes and the virus.
A gap opened between the junior staff and the bosses.
quiet: The drug blocks signals from the brain to the tumor.
Bad feeling grew among the mothers at the school.
Data flows from the database through a single node.
Friction arose on the farm when the owner left.
Trade routes ran along the coast to the mines.
The treaty keeps the mountain tribes at peace.
It measures the size of the virus in cells.
A gap opened in the fence behind the staff room.

short: first plural in 'between the Xs and the Ys'
notes: Other plurals with no 'between' also fired weakly in the top examples ('shutter times', 'inks'); singular 'between the house and the road' stayed at 0.01.
